variables.input:
fetch logs
| filterOut outsystems.app.name == ""
| sort outsystems.app.name asc
| summarize collectDistinct(outsystems.app.name)

fetch logs
| fieldsAdd strTenant=toString(outsystems.tenant.id)
| sort strTenant asc
| summarize collectDistinct(outsystems.tenant.id)

fetch logs
| fieldsAdd strTenant=toString(deployment.environment)
| sort strTenant asc
| summarize collectDistinct(deployment.environment)

0.content: ⚠️ Extension/Timer duration is in **seconds** at the OutSystems source, confirmed for both log streaming and the Logstash `db-extension.conf`/`db-timer.conf` pipelines (they copy the raw DB column verbatim). The MonitorProbe-sourced pipelines (`app-extension.conf`/`app-timer.conf`) are **unverified** and may report a different unit — see [Documentation/OTEL-Field-Mapping.md](https://github.com/StefanPostma/Outsystems-Dynatrace-Log-Integration/blob/main/Documentation/OTEL-Field-Mapping.md#extension).

2.query:
fetch logs
| filter outsystems.log.type == "Extension"
| filter in(outsystems.app.name, $Application)
| filter in(deployment.environment, $Environment)
| filter in(outsystems.tenant.id, $Tenant)
| filter isNotNull(outsystems.request.duration)
| summarize AvgDuration = avg(toDouble(outsystems.request.duration) * 1s), MaxDuration = max(toDouble(outsystems.request.duration) * 1s), Count = count(), by: {Application = outsystems.app.name, Extension = outsystems.code.function.owner}
| sort AvgDuration desc
| limit 20

4.query:
fetch logs
| filter outsystems.log.type == "CyclicJob"
| filter in(outsystems.app.name, $Application)
| filter in(deployment.environment, $Environment)
| filter in(outsystems.tenant.id, $Tenant)
| filter isNotNull(outsystems.request.duration)
| summarize AvgDuration = avg(toDouble(outsystems.request.duration) * 1s), MaxDuration = max(toDouble(outsystems.request.duration) * 1s), Count = count(), by: {Application = outsystems.app.name, Timer = code.function}
| sort AvgDuration desc
| limit 20

5.content:
### Timer drift — scheduled vs. actual start
Positive drift means the timer started later than scheduled

6.query:
fetch logs
| filter outsystems.log.type == "CyclicJob"
| filter in(outsystems.app.name, $Application)
| filter in(deployment.environment, $Environment)
| filter in(outsystems.tenant.id, $Tenant)
| filter isNotNull(outsystems.timer.shouldhaverunat)
| fieldsAdd ActualStart = timestamp - (toDouble(outsystems.request.duration) * 1s)
| fieldsAdd Drift = ActualStart - toTimestamp(outsystems.timer.shouldhaverunat)
| fields Application = outsystems.app.name, Timer = code.function, ScheduledAt = outsystems.timer.shouldhaverunat, ActualStart, Drift, NextRun = outsystems.timer.nextrun
| sort Drift desc
| limit 20
